gate.gateRule: Requires actual owner ready:true, activeConflicts:[], reservedTiles covering all four assigned tiles, no target in-flight overlap and no conflicting current selection. Coordinate preparation alone grants no reservation.

recommendedSequence.strategy: Fill c11 completely before c12. Within each formal tile column, fill native patch column1..4; for each patch column advance north-to-south through all four r10 rows then all four r11 rows. Every step has a stable or previously selected west source; subsequent rows also have an earlier north source.
